issues.title: Insecure Cleartext Transmission (No HTTPS)
issues.description: Website operates over plain unencrypted HTTP port 80 without SSL/TLS cryptographic encryption.
issues.impact: Passwords, session cookies, and sensitive payloads can be sniffed or modified via Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks.
issues.recommendation: Install a trusted SSL certificate (e.g. Let's Encrypt) and enforce 301 redirect from HTTP to HTTPS.

issues.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
issues.description: The "Strict-Transport-Security" header is absent, permitting unencrypted HTTP downgrade attacks.
issues.impact: Attackers can execute SSL stripping attacks on public Wi-Fi networks to intercept communications.
issues.recommendation: Add header: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload

issues.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
issues.description: The "Content-Security-Policy" header is not configured, leaving script execution unrestricted.
issues.impact: Substantially elevates vulnerability to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and rogue script injection.
issues.recommendation: Configure a Content-Security-Policy header restricting script-src, object-src, and default-src directives.

issues.title: Missing MIME Sniffing Protection (X-Content-Type-Options)
issues.impact: Browsers may interpret non-executable assets as executable script content if MIME type is ambiguous.

issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
issues.description: No explicit Referrer-Policy is configured on outgoing navigation.
issues.impact: Sensitive URL parameters and tokens may leak to third-party domains via the Referer request header.

issues.title: Server Build Version Disclosure
issues.description: Web server exposes internal software stack details: "Apache/2.4.56 (Win64) OpenSSL/1.1.1t PHP/8.2.4".
issues.impact: Adversaries can correlate precise version numbers with published CVE exploits and weaponized payloads.
issues.recommendation: Disable verbose banner signatures (e.g., ServerTokens Prod in Apache, server_tokens off in Nginx).

issues.title: Application Runtime Disclosure (X-Powered-By)
issues.description: Backend runtime framework leaked in response header: "PHP/8.2.4".
issues.impact: Informs automated attack scanners about the exact backend execution environment.
issues.recommendation: Disable the X-Powered-By header (e.g. app.disable("x-powered-by") in Express, expose_php = Off in php.ini).
